attchmntText: Palash Securities Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Palash Securities Limited has published extracts of its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The publication appeared in The Business Standard in English and Hindi, specifically the Lucknow Edition, on Saturday, November 14, 2026. This disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company has submitted the copies of the newspaper extracts to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited for their records. The communication was signed by Vikram Kumar Mishra, Company Secretary, with membership number FCS 11269.

attchmntText: Palash Securities Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Palash Securities Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, along with the Auditors’ Limited Review Report. Standalone net profit for the quarter was 181.18 lakhs, compared to a loss of 5.47 lakhs in the previous quarter. Half year standalone net profit stood at 175.71 lakhs. Consolidated results were also reviewed. The meeting commenced at 4:00 p.m. and concluded at 5:45 p.m. The financial statements are available on the company website.
